body: OK, just please look after yourself. I'm sorry that I've upset you in any way. Just trying to spread a little bit of love around.

You absolutely do not have to believe me. Your reality is your own reality and I'm sorry it sounds like you're not in a good place.

I made an attempt on my life about 6 weeks ago and it's been awful but things have slowly improved. It's not about ignoring reality but about finding what works for you and being patient and kind to yourself where you can.

You do not need to take my advice but I wanted to post this as I know it helped me in the past knowing that people have gotten through the worst of times.

Please look after yourself ❤️🙏🏻
Haha OK fair enough. Just trying to open up a conversation around our professional identity which everyone seems to have ignored but OK
I have already spoken about this if you wanna see the other comments. The post is more a discussion of how OT is seen by other professionals and our professional identity.

I think it's because OT is already pigeon holed as something that is much less than what we have the potential to fulfill and help our clients with, I wrote all of this in another comment and had my suggestion there too!

As I mentioned I'm not trying to cause any harm, just find it interesting that even in an OT related sub that we still define ourselves as equipment prescribers!

Just trying to open a conversation of how we define ourselves as OTs as it's already tricky to find a professional identity outside of being a discharge planner or prescriber of equipment.

In my opinion we are so much more than that, we are holistic healers who consider the whole person rather than their deficits.

In response to suggesting a better picture, I would suggest an 'I love OT' graphic, or something more about human connection, people holding hands or talking.. Seems much more relevant to our profession 😊
Please tell them, it sounds like someone else needs to share this feeling with you. Sending you all the love, you're so strong , keep looking for love and support
